summary: Clark County, WI hill (South Mound) where the FFLA lists a tower as gone; a climbing page says a fire tower stood there long ago and the land is private.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; a climbing page says a fire tower stood on the hill long ago

access.note: South Mound is private property; per the SummitPost climbing page, few climbers get permission to hike it

notes_for_editor: The link between the FFLA Tioga entry and South Mound rests on coordinates and the county: the FFLA point, the OSM point and the SummitPost summit point are all within roughly 300 m of each other, and the climbing page is the only source that says a fire tower stood on South Mound. The Forest Lookouts Wisconsin page lists a Tioga entry under Clark County with no notes, so it is not cited. No source gives a build date, design, height or removal date. The OSM elevation (428, presumably metres) was not used. A Clark County history file or DNR record could confirm the same hill and supply dates.
